The <b>Hunter's Cloak</b> is an [[Items (Silksong)#Equipment|equipment item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It is [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s default cloak and one of the first items available in her inventory.

== Function ==
The Hunter's Cloak serves no gameplay function until it gets upgraded.

== How to Acquire ==
The Hunter's Cloak is available in the inventory from the beginning of the game in Moss Grotto.

== In-game Events ==
As [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] meets more [[NPCs (Silksong)|characters]] throughout [[Pharloom]] she gets recognised by the colour of her cloak, with some characters pointing it out directly by giving her nicknames, such as "Red maiden" by [[Sherma]],<ref>[[Sherma]]: <i>"Join your voice with mine, red maiden! You, me, and my lucky chime will sing together until the great gate opens!"</i></ref> and "Bug-Red" by [[Twelfth Architect]].<ref>[[Twelfth Architect]]: <i>"Bug-Red. Do you ask-need our service? We shall create, as is our d-d-directive. To serve, for Pharloom eternal."</i></ref>

=== Upgrades ===
When meeting the [[Seamstress]], she mentions how the Hunter's Cloak alone would not suffice for Hornet to traverse the [[Far Fields]] and that it would need the help of her sewing skills. After completing the <i>[[Flexile Spines]]</i> [[wish]], the Seamstress takes the cloak and upgrades it into the [[Drifter's Cloak]], allowing Hornet to float in the air and catch updraft winds.<ref>[[Seamstress]]: <i>"If you're planning to ascend from these low fields, you'll be needing some lift, and I'm just the bug to help."</i></ref>

Once Hornet reaches the tuning fork at the peak of [[Mount Fay]] and plays the [[Needolin]], the [[Fayforn]] descends and grants Hornet her down to create the [[Faydown Cloak]]. The [[Mask Maker (Silksong)|Mask Maker]] seems impressed with this gift and with the fact that the Fayforn has lent Hornet her aid.<ref>[[Mask Maker (Silksong)|Mask Maker]]: <i>"To pass something so precious... That's a mighty gift you've been given. Seems she's thrown her lot in with you."</i></ref>

=== The Slab ===
After getting [[The Slab#Capture by Wardenfly|captured]] and taken to [[the Slab]], Hornet wakes up and finds herself [[Cloakless Crest|lacking all her items]], including her [[Needle]] and cloak. Making her way through the prison, she eventually finds a [[Wardenfly]] using her equipment, so she proceeds to sneak up on them and retrieve her belongings.

Upon escaping the Slab, Hornet's cloak will reek with the smell from the prison flies, which will persist until she washes it away by going into bodies of water.<ref group="Note">Any body of water is sufficient to wash Hornet's cloak of the fly smell. The [[muckmaggot]]-infested waters in [[Bilewater]] and [[Putrified Ducts]], as well as the sea of [[Void]] in [[The Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]] while Hornet has the [[Everbloom]], are treated as water for the purposes of cleaning the cloak.</ref>

The cloak's inventory description also changes depending on its current state.
